official_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
objective: Provide monthly pension to BPL persons with severe or multiple disabilities (80% or more) aged 18-79 years under the National Social Assistance Programme.
description: IGNDPS is a component of NSAP providing monthly pension to BPL persons with 80% or more disability. Central Government contribution: Rs 300/month for age 18-79 years, Rs 500/month for age 80 years and above. Disability must be certified by a competent medical authority. Pension disbursed through DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account.
implementing_agency: State/UT Governments, District Administration, Gram Panchayats/ULBs
